title: Learning
description: What a free course or certification is, how long it takes and what the certificate costs (Eligibility PRD, Chapter 11). Only for kinds course and certification. Referenced from resource.schema.json.

format.description: cohort = a batch with enrolment dates (put the dates in offer_window); self_paced = start any time.

hours.description: Total learning time as the provider states it.

items.description: ISO 639-1 language code, lower case (en, ur).

certificate.description: none = no certificate. free = a certificate at no cost. paid_optional = you can learn free and pay for a certificate. paid_required = the learning is free but any proof of completion costs money (needs the paid_certificate badge).

certificate_price.description: What the certificate costs, as the provider states it. Say it for paid_optional and paid_required.

credential.description: completion = a completion document. badge = a digital badge. professional_certificate and specialization = a multi-course credential. accredited_credit = counts toward a degree.

exam_voucher.description: Whether the program gives a free or discounted certification exam voucher.

items.description: Target role as a slug, for example data-analyst, cloud-engineer, teacher.
